coverage: Four bounded concurrent requests reassemble non-divisible byte lengths with a full SHA-256 check
Strict range status, position, total size and byte-length checks; expired, redirected and corrupt responses rejected
Failed range cancels pending peers and removes the partial file
Invalid inputs and existing destination files are not fetched, overwritten or deleted
Large runtime integration: verified range download, one authorized origin fallback, no Docker load if both sources fail integrity
New timing counters pass through the callback allowlist; unknown and invalid timing fields are dropped
harnessNote: The first SSH setup returned without test output and was not counted. The explicit non-interactive LXD test command then verified all 328 input hashes and reported 211 passing checks.
scope: Full local and isolated Linux suites. Native whole-product acceptance of the new range path remains a separate gate.
